svg.text: Splitting long jobs: find first 7×7, thread by thread
each row is one of 32 threads · same code (commit 009297a), splitting switched off and on · median of 5 runs
jobs are tested in lexicographic order; once a job is known to hold the first grid, only the jobs before it matter.
Without splitting, one thread walks a huge earlier job alone. With it, an idle thread lets the long job be cut into pieces that all threads share.
